summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built generative language and speech models from scratch in PyTorch, including a GPT-2 style Transformer and a Whisper-style ASR decoder, and fine-tuned transformer models (DONUT, TinyLlama) with evaluation across benchmark suites such as HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC. Comfortable moving between classical ML and current generative architectures, with hands-on experience curating scientific datasets and validating models for real-world deployment.

Computer Vision & Scientific Imaging: Medical & scientific imaging (MRI, microscopic materials inspection)

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built PyTorch training pipelines using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder with domain-specific tokens.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Built a custom image-stitching and wavelet-denoising pipeline for microscopic materials inspection, improving PSNR from 65 to 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with augmentation and memory-managed batch loading.
Trained U-Net segmentation (VGG-16/19, ResNet-50); evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, restructuring tasks to deliver on a 6-week deadline.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, weight tying.
Built a TikToken tokenizer and training loop with early stopping; validated text generation via perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC: <1% accuracy loss with +0.09 perplexity increase, a near-lossless compression.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline (mel spectrogram encoder, causal Transformer decoder) achieving 15% WER.
Designed a Cython-accelerated BPE tokenizer with a 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python.
